title: Knowledge check — 8 questions
note: Unlocks after the applied activity is submitted. Retakes are free and unlimited.

questions.prompt: Why does shared authorship across the two coaching studies strengthen the evidence? `[V]`
options: Because it demonstrates the researcher's expertise across both methods
Because a researcher publishing a null result that constrains a category they helped launch is self-correction, which is rare and is the opposite of the motivated reasoning you would suspect
Because it means the two studies used identical methodology
Because it rules out publication bias in the field
questions.explanation: The cheap readings (the early study was wrong, the later one is biased, two camps disagree) are all unavailable. One researcher published a positive narrow result and then a null broad one.

questions.prompt: What distinguishes the application that worked from the one that didn't?
options: Sample size and study duration
The seniority of the participants
Narrow and measurable versus broad and relational
Whether the intervention was voluntary or assigned
questions.explanation: Goal attainment is bounded, targeted, and checkable. Broad developmental coaching depends on a mechanism a tool can't supply, which Lesson 2 names.

questions.prompt: What is co-regulation, as the module uses it?
options: A shared governance model between L&D and the business for development programs
The coach and coachee jointly setting and revising goals over time
A second nervous system in the room — a witness whose opinion of you is at stake, which makes disclosure expensive, and the expense is what makes it work
Matching the intervention's intensity to the learner's current capability
questions.explanation: And the consequence is that an interlocutor with no stake in you isn't a cheaper version of one who has. It is a different intervention using the same words.

questions.prompt: How does the module explain the higher attrition in the AI arm?
options: The interface was harder to use than meeting a human coach
Nothing was holding participants there — nobody would notice if they stopped
Participants found the advice lower in quality and disengaged
Scheduling flexibility made it easier to defer sessions indefinitely
questions.explanation: Which follows directly from co-regulation. The accountability was the mechanism, so removing the witness removed the thing keeping people in the programme.

questions.prompt: Why does the module treat the self-efficacy finding as a design constraint rather than an equity point? `[V]`
options: Because equity considerations are covered elsewhere in the curriculum

Because for this role it predicts the shape of your results: an unsupervised tool-based program produces bimodal outcomes, and your evaluation will average a group it worked for with a group it failed
Because equity framing makes the finding harder to fund
Because the finding is about program design rather than about individuals
questions.explanation: It is an equity point too: the business partner track treats it that way. The version that changes what an L&D professional builds is the measurement one, because the group averaged away is the group the program was justified by.

questions.prompt: What does the module recommend for evaluating a tool-based development program?
options: Increase the sample size until the average is statistically reliable
Measure completion and satisfaction, which are the outcomes tools reliably improve
Baseline confidence or self-efficacy at entry and report outcomes split, because an average is a choice not to see the finding
Compare against a matched cohort receiving human coaching
questions.explanation: D is a fine study design and rarely available in practice. C is what makes the bimodal result visible with data you can actually collect.

options: That L&D loses headcount as development activities are automated

That routing development conversations to a tool may preserve the content while removing the scheduled occasion for a manager and their report to talk about the future — which was doing work far beyond development
That managers lose the skill of running development conversations through disuse
That employees disclose less over time as they learn the tool is not confidential
questions.explanation: C is a real and related risk; the module's point is stronger. The meeting produced a relationship, the agenda was just the reason for it, and nothing else on the calendar has that agenda.

questions.prompt: A learner's allocation policy states that senior leaders get human coaches because that is what the budget allows. How should that be treated?
options: As a failure to apply the module's evidence, since the self-efficacy finding argues the opposite
As a legitimate and more defensible basis than a claim about who benefits most, provided it is stated openly rather than smuggled in as a judgment
As acceptable only if paired with a plan to extend coaching to other groups
As evidence the organization has not made an allocation decision at all
questions.explanation: Budget is a real constraint and naming it is the honest move. The failure the module targets is a budget decision dressed as a developmental judgment, which can't be argued with because it isn't stating its actual reason.
